answer_1.quote: The neural machine translation task seeks to model the translation probability P(y|x, c; Θ) using a conditional language model based on Transformer architecture
answer_1.outputs: translated English sentences from Chinese input

answer_2.quote: For automatic translation evaluation, we report the classical BLEU scores with SacreBLEU.

answer_4.quote: We sampled 200 instances from four corpora, and hired two workers to rate the translation results of pro-dropP&T, HanNMT, CsaNMT and our model based on the above three aspects.
answer_4.guideline: We used Best-Worst Scaling, which has been shown to produce more reliable results than ranking scales. Specifically, each score is computed as the percentage of times it was selected as best minus the percentage of times it was selected as worst, and ranges from -1 (unanimously worst) to +1 (unanimously best).
